chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazee' from Abu Isma'il al-Sarraj, who said:

Mu'awiya ibn Wahb said to me and took my hand, saying: He said to me, Abu Hamza said to me and took my hand, saying: Al-Asbagh ibn Nubata said to me and took my hand, and showed me the seventh pillar, and said: This is the standing place of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him). He said: And al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon him) used to pray near the fifth pillar, and when the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was absent, al-Hasan (peace be upon him) would pray in it, and it is from the door of Kindah.
ai.seo_question: Where did Imam Ali and Imam Hasan pray inside the Kaaba?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* identifies the seventh pillar (Ustuwana) in the Kaaba as the specific standing place of Imam Ali (AS) and the fifth pillar as the prayer spot of Imam Hasan (AS), highlighting the spiritual merit of these locations. It reflects the Shia tradition of linking specific architectural elements of the Kaaba to the Imams, emphasizing their unique status and the virtue of praying at these designated spots.
